audience: marketers and operations teams using BounceBan to review contact addresses

useCases.title: Check credits and account limits
useCases.text: Read BounceBan verification credits and account rate limits before starting new checks. These allowances are shared across the account’s API keys.

useCases.title: Verify a single contact address
useCases.text: Confirm credit usage to verify one email. If the result is pending, keep its task ID and check that existing task later instead of submitting another verification.

useCases.title: Verify a contact list in bulk
useCases.text: Confirm credit usage to submit 1–1,000 email addresses for asynchronous verification, then read the task’s progress and aggregate results. Wait between status checks.

useCases.title: Review an existing bulk task’s results
useCases.text: Check the task’s status, then read up to 100 existing email results. Follow further pages only when a continuation cursor is returned; pending tasks need time to finish.
